description.value: Morning Tide Eatery is a modern brunch spot in Coquitlam, owned by a local Tri-Cities couple who wanted to bring quality, creative brunch to the suburbs without the long city drives and waits. The menu blends classic brunch staples with Asian-inspired touches, including a house-made longanisa (sweet Filipino pork patty) sandwich with atchara, alongside eggs benedict, loaded bowls, and fried chicken. The restaurant is located within a bowling alley complex, lending it an unexpected and memorable setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Morning Tide Eatery is a real, operating brunch restaurant located at 8 228 Schoolhouse St, Coquitlam BC — not North Vancouver as OSM tags indicate, which is a notable discrepancy. The menu page clearly labels plant-based, vegan (V), and gluten-free (GF) options, and the contact page explicitly confirms takeout and delivery via Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and DoorDash. Washrooms are confirmed on the website but noted as only accessible through an adjacent bowling alley; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website address is 8 228 Schoolhouse St, Coquitlam BC V3K 6V7 — this is a different municipality and the OSM community tag should be corrected to Coquitlam.
OSM record has no address, phone, or email; all contact details were sourced from the website only.
The OSM lat/lon (49.2370, -122.8530) should be verified against the Coquitlam address to ensure the pin is correctly placed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating brunch restaurant with an active website, menu, and contact details confirmed. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial brunch with vegan and GF options.
enrichment_extras.notes: Brunch-only restaurant (Wed–Sun). Washrooms require passing through the adjacent bowling alley.

Washrooms.detail: Washrooms confirmed on-site but only accessible through the adjacent bowling alley, per the contact page

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels plant-based bowl with 'V' (vegan), gluten-free options noted with 'GF' throughout, and gluten-free English muffin available as a substitution
